title: ui: remove the view columnState reads left after its retirement (list renderer rung, overlay owned keys, view tabs)
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Follow-up from #36403 (PR #36435, retire the view `columnState` key). The PR names these leftovers as owed and the L1 found two more. Filed by the seat. Parent: #36403.

## What happens

After #36435 the spec no longer accepts a view `columnState`, but four ui sites still name it. None breaks anything: each reads a key that is now always absent. They mislead the next reader into thinking the key is live.

- `objectViewListRenderer.tsx` around line 787: a fallback rung that reads `columnState` behind `as any`.
- data-objectstack `index.ts` around line 3349: the `'columnState'` entry in `VIEW_OVERLAY_OWNED_KEYS`, and the comments around lines 3301 and 3328.
- app-shell `objectViewTabs.ts` around line 502.

The plugin-grid and personal-views uses are a separate runtime key and stay as they are.

## To do

1. Remove the rung, the overlay entry and the `objectViewTabs.ts` read, and correct the comments.
2. Keep each removal pinned by the existing tests; add none for a key the schema already refuses.

## Acceptance

- No ui source outside plugin-grid and personal views names the view `columnState` key, and Type Check UI and Test UI stay green.

Blocked-by: #36435

## Grade
p3 · domain:ui. Dead reads, no behaviour change.
